metadata.description: Claude skills for Israeli law students

plugins.name: ruling-analyzer
plugins.description: Analyze an Israeli court ruling from a case number, the parties' names or an attached file, and show it as a visual study card with a pin for every claim.

plugins.name: lecture-summarizer
plugins.description: Summarize a law lecture from a transcript, notes or slides into a visual study card, with transcript cleaning and verified case citations.

plugins.name: exam-simulator
plugins.description: Run a practice exam for a law course from a topic, a lecture card, a ruling card or a syllabus section, then grade the answer and outline a strong one.

plugins.name: law-student-pack
plugins.description: All the skills for Israeli law students: ruling analyzer, lecture summarizer, exam simulator
